business_problem: Citizens Bank needed to replace fragmented, batch-oriented fraud systems so it could detect new check and deposit fraud patterns in near real time and roll out new defenses far faster than days or weeks.
solution_summary: Citizens Bank built a comprehensive fraud management platform on MongoDB Atlas on AWS to consolidate legacy applications into a cloud-based system for monitoring, alerts, and disputes. The first application scans checks, deposits, ACH transactions, wire transfers, and other payment events in near real time, while the alerts management application packages the relevant context for fraud operations teams to investigate suspicious activity quickly. A third claims and disputes application lets eligible customers file digitally instead of calling a contact center and equips representatives with customer data to resolve cases faster. By combining Atlas's flexible schema with real-time processing, the bank can adapt fraud rules, onboard new transaction types, and launch a new strategy into production in minutes instead of the old days-to-weeks cycle.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores fraud events and powers the bank's monitoring, alerts, and disputes applications on AWS with the flexibility needed for real-time rule changes.

data_flow: Checks, deposits, ACH, wire, ATM, and point-of-sale events flow into a monitoring and detection application on MongoDB Atlas, suspicious activity is passed to alerts management for investigation, and dispute data is exposed through digital claims channels and customer-service workflows.
business_outcome: Citizens Bank reduced fraud losses and false positives, cut strategy deployment from days or weeks to minutes, improved contact-center efficiency, and built a cloud fraud platform that can expand to more transaction types and future AI enhancements.
metrics: Citizens Bank ran an 18-20-month transformation of its fraud management systems in 2023.
